questions.q2: Under the current best Toutiao config (#38), how is libmetasec_ml handled — loaded/failed/skipped, crash, effect on visible features — vs the Android reference?

q1_app_domain.answer: YES. The Bionic linker64 and libc can be loaded (open + mmap PROT_EXEC) in the real app domain (u:r:normal_hap:s0, uid 20010053) from the appdat runtime root inside the app private namespace — the identical result to the production libart.so the app already loads — with 0 SELinux denials and no sepolicy change. The load path is dlopen/mmap after fork+setcon, so the execve and global-/data/local/tmp denials (data_local_tmp label) are irrelevant to it. Method note: entering normal_hap via setcon from the permissive su shell reproduces the app's own fork+setcon; global-tmp denials were dontaudit-suppressed (measured by exit code and EACCES, not by dmesg line count, since the ring buffer wraps).

q2_metasec.interpretation: On OH, metasec is in a loaded-but-not-initialized state: dlopen succeeds via the bionic shim (repeatedly re-requested, vs Android's single ok) but MSTaskManager::DoLazyInit — the actual security init — never executes. The initial feed does not hard-depend on it (3 items render), but signed/deep operations do. DoLazyInit is exactly where metasec's Bionic-ABI assumptions live (pthread slot1==pthread_self, cached_pid@20, static vfork — per #35); under OH musl + shim that init does not complete.
q2_metasec.answer: Loaded (dlopen via shim, no error, no crash), but NOT functionally initialized — MSTaskManager::DoLazyInit never runs on OH, whereas it runs on the Android reference. metasec does not crash and does not block the initial feed; it is not the current visible-feature blocker (input/focus + the ART worker crash are). Its full anti-tamper/signing is unconfirmed and most likely inert under musl+shim.

recommendation.verdict: advance the Bionic route, but stage it behind the current input/focus + ART-worker-crash blockers
why: Q1 removes the SELinux unknown: loading real Bionic into the app process is permitted with no policy change and 0 denials (proven in the app domain).
Q2 shows metasec loads but its DoLazyInit does not run under musl+shim; making it run as on Android is the concrete payoff of real Bionic (its ABI assumptions live in that init).

But metasec is NOT today's binding blocker: the feed already renders and the visible failures are input/focus (#34/#38) and an ART worker crash. Bionic is a stability/correctness investment (~98 person-days of shims + ART boot-image matching per #39), not a quick unlock.
recommendation.next_bionic_step: M2 (#43): dalvikvm64 with AOSP14 ART/i18n APEX + boot image + BCP + the #39 Bionic linker/libc, to check ART itself runs on real Bionic before committing to the 57-lib rebuild.
